build_facial_model: build a facial attributes analysis stream using ResNet18 with configurable pooling and fully connected layers
build_lipreading_model: build a lipreading network stream with TCN options and backbone configuration loaded from a JSON config file
build_unet_audio: build a VisualVoice UNet audio separation model with configurable feature dimensions and weight initialization
build_vocal_model: build a vocal attributes analysis stream using ResNet18 with single-channel audio input and configurable output dimensions
load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained weights into a model builder stream with shape-matched state dictionary filtering
